## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Sòng-period Esoteric ritual manual by **Dānapāla** ([施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7)) on a practice associated with **Indra's Cliff** (*Dìshìyán* 帝釋巖 — Skt. *Indraśailaguhā*, the famous cliff-cave near Rājagṛha where Indra is said to have visited the Buddha and asked the questions of the *Sakkapañha-suttanta*).

**Abstract**

The text gives an Esoteric ritual practice associated with the Indra's Cliff site — likely a *sādhana* invoking Indra and the cosmic-protective deities of the eastern direction in the Vajradhātu mandala. The translation dates from Dānapāla's Yìjīngyuàn period (985–1017).
